_: Copy and structure of pricing.html, read by scripts/make-marketing-pages.mjs (which writes the committed HTML). `groups` maps EVERY plan-matrix.json feature row that any paid plan has to one comparison group; the table is built from plan-matrix.json at generation time, so a cell cannot say what the matrix does not, and `npm run test:marketing` fails when a row is in no group, in two groups, or a key here is not a matrix row. Fields ending in Html are our own trusted markup (an em, a stamped span); everything else is escaped. No price, no plan name and no figure is typed here: those are stamped at build time from src/lib/plans.js and src/data/plan-matrix.json. No social proof of any kind.

meta.title: Pricing: pay once, yours for good
meta.description: Three plans, each bought once in Indian rupees with no subscription and no renewal. Compare what Basic, Intermediate and Pro include, feature by feature.

hero.sub: Three plans, and each one includes everything in the plan below it. Every plan is a single payment in Indian rupees: no subscription, no renewal, nothing to cancel.

trial.h: Not sure yet? Try the whole studio free
trial.bodyHtml: Every module, on the Dragon and The Dark Knight sample films, for a limited time. No card required. Then keep the plan that fits.

plans.lede: Every plan is bought once, never renews and never lapses. Move up a plan later by paying the difference.
plans.alt: or start the free trial first
plans.noteHtml: One-time list prices in Indian rupees, paid through Razorpay and confirmed at checkout. The learning library and your local work are on every plan. A plan is final apart from the three cases in the Refund and Cancellation Policy, which is why the free trial comes first.

offer.h: The price goes up, and the date is already set.
offer.line: Today's figure is the launch price. It rises on a date held by the server, or once the launch seats are taken, whichever comes first.
offer.fine: Nothing here resets. The rise is scheduled on the server and fires by itself, so reloading this page shows you less time, never more.

compare.lede: Generated from the same list the studio uses to decide what to open, so it cannot disagree with the product.
